snippet.title: Egg Over It: Fall Flat From the Top - Official Trailer - Europa - Audio English
snippet.description:
Egg Over It: Fall Flat From the Top. Tactical jumping to lift the egg as high as you can. Out now on PC and Switch.

🎮 Get it now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1948110/
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/es-es/Juegos/Programas-descargables-Nintendo-Switch/Egg-Over-It-Fall-Flat-from-the-Top-2240735.html

A real tactical jumping adventure: lift the egg to the top in search of its source. Explore carefully, because a single failed jump can send you a long way down.
• Tactical jumping
• One mistake can cost you the whole climb
• Single-player
